summary: Hardened the Games feature for GA. Implemented approval-based joins, private game invitations, host management tools, stable pagination, and auditable in-app notifications across API, Web, and Mobile.

environment_readiness.infra_evidence: PostgreSQL and Redis containers are healthy.

major_decisions.decision: Used 8-character random alphanumeric tokens for private game invitations.
major_decisions.reason: Balances ease of manual entry on mobile with sufficient entropy to prevent brute-forcing.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Requires Host to explicitly generate and share codes.

major_decisions.decision: Implemented store-only in-app notifications with read tracking.
major_decisions.reason: Provides a foundation for user communication and audit trail before full push integration.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Users must check the app to see updates; push delivery is deferred to a later step.

major_decisions.decision: Switched API tests to run sequentially and used unique test user emails per file.
major_decisions.reason: Prevents database row collisions and relation conflicts during parallel test execution.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Slightly longer test duration but significantly higher reliability.

tests.name: API Games Hardening Tests
tests.notes: Covers Approval joins, Private invitations, and Pagination.

tests.name: API Auth Tests
tests.notes: Verified logout and protection with isolated users.

acceptance_checklist.evidence: Implemented in API and UI; tested in games_hardening.test.ts.
Visibility support added; invite token redemption tested.
Approvals and invite generation available in Web and Mobile detail views.
Notifications persisted for key events and viewable in dedicated screens.

errors.error: 401 errors and foreign key violations during parallel test runs.
errors.how_fixed_or_next_steps: Isolated test users with unique emails and set Vitest to run sequentially for API.

errors.error: Explicit any types in notifications payload.

next_recommendations: Integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for real-time push notifications.
Implement real-time game status updates using WebSockets (Socket.io).
Add 'Share' functionality to easily send Invite Codes to external apps.

rules_summary.approval_flow: Users request join; Host approves/denies; Notifications triggered at each step.
rules_summary.private_invites: 8-char alphanumeric tokens; Host-generated; Required for private visibility.
rules_summary.waitlist_policy: Automatic promotion on vacancy; Promotion follows joinPolicy (instant or requested).
rules_summary.pagination_strategy: Stable cursor-based pagination using [startTime, id] fields.
